errors.text: The proposed AlCoCrFeNi stationary-friction-processing route does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo powder plus spark-plasma-sintering intervention.
The hypothesis does not address densification or predict relative density, despite density being a central optimization objective and the target result being 96.7% relative density.
The claimed stabilization of a BCC/B2 matrix by SFP is not supported by the cited SFP evidence, which reports substantial transformation to FCC.
Oxidation improvement measured for SFP at 400 rpm is extrapolated to 1800 rpm from surface-free-energy data alone; oxidation performance at 1800 rpm is not established.
The 1200 K processing boundary is imported from a molecular-dynamics friction study of FeNiCrCoCu on Cu and is not a valid melting or disorder limit for bulk AlCoCrFeNi SFP.
The proposed aqueous-corrosion mechanism is largely unsupported: molten-salt corrosion evidence cannot establish passivation behavior in 3.5 wt% NaCl.
